verses.zh: 智慧子听父亲的教训；亵慢人不听责备。
verses.kjv: A wise son heareth his father’s instruction: but a scorner heareth not rebuke.
verses.en: A wise son listens to his father's teaching, but someone who sneers will not listen to correction.

verses.zh: 人因口所结的果子，必享美福；奸诈人必遭强暴。
verses.kjv: A man shall eat good by the fruit of his mouth: but the soul of the transgressors shall eat violence.
verses.en: A person enjoys good things from what they say, but cheats hunger for violence.

verses.zh: 谨守口的，得保生命；大张嘴的，必致败亡。
verses.kjv: He that keepeth his mouth keepeth his life: but he that openeth wide his lips shall have destruction.
verses.en: Guarding your mouth guards your life; opening it wide brings ruin.

verses.zh: 懒惰人羡慕，却无所得；殷勤人必得丰裕。
verses.kjv: The soul of the sluggard desireth, and hath nothing: but the soul of the diligent shall be made fat.
verses.en: A lazy person wants things but gets nothing; a hard-working person gets plenty.

verses.zh: 义人恨恶谎言；恶人有臭名，且致惭愧。
verses.kjv: A righteous man hateth lying: but a wicked man is loathsome, and cometh to shame.
verses.en: A good person hates lying; a bad person earns a bad name and ends up ashamed.

verses.zh: 行为正直的，有公义保守；犯罪的，被邪恶倾覆。
verses.kjv: Righteousness keepeth him that is upright in the way: but wickedness overthroweth the sinner.
verses.en: Doing right keeps an honest person safe, but doing wrong knocks a sinner over.

verses.zh: 假作富足的，却一无所有；装作穷乏的，却广有财物。
verses.kjv: There is that maketh himself rich, yet hath nothing: there is that maketh himself poor, yet hath great riches.
verses.en: One person pretends to be rich and has nothing; another pretends to be poor and has plenty.

verses.zh: 人的资财是他生命的赎价；穷乏人却听不见威吓的话。
verses.kjv: The ransom of a man’s life are his riches: but the poor heareth not rebuke.
verses.en: A rich person may have to pay to save their life, but a poor person never even hears the threat.

verses.zh: 义人的光明亮；恶人的灯要熄灭。
verses.kjv: The light of the righteous rejoiceth: but the lamp of the wicked shall be put out.
verses.en: A good person's light shines brightly, but a bad person's lamp goes out.

verses.zh: 骄傲只启争竞；听劝言的，却有智慧。
verses.kjv: Only by pride cometh contention: but with the well advised is wisdom.
verses.en: Pride only starts arguments, but those who take advice are wise.

verses.zh: 不劳而得之财必然消耗；勤劳积蓄的，必见加增。
verses.kjv: Wealth gotten by vanity shall be diminished: but he that gathereth by labour shall increase.
verses.en: Money that comes too easily disappears, but saving little by little makes it grow.

verses.zh: 所盼望的迟延未得，令人心忧；所愿意的临到，却是生命树。
verses.kjv: Hope deferred maketh the heart sick: but when the desire cometh, it is a tree of life.
verses.en: Hoping for something that never comes makes the heart sick, but getting what you longed for is a tree of life.

verses.zh: 藐视训言的，自取灭亡；敬畏诫命的，必得善报。
verses.kjv: Whoso despiseth the word shall be destroyed: but he that feareth the commandment shall be rewarded.
verses.en: Whoever laughs at good teaching brings ruin on themselves, but whoever respects a command is rewarded.

verses.zh: 智慧人的法则是生命的泉源，可以使人离开死亡的网罗。
verses.kjv: The law of the wise is a fountain of life, to depart from the snares of death.
verses.en: A wise person's teaching is a fountain of life that turns you away from deadly traps.

verses.zh: 美好的聪明使人蒙恩；奸诈人的道路崎岖难行。
verses.kjv: Good understanding giveth favour: but the way of transgressors is hard.
verses.en: Good sense wins people over, but the road of cheats is rough going.

verses.zh: 凡通达人都凭知识行事；愚昧人张扬自己的愚昧。
verses.kjv: Every prudent man dealeth with knowledge: but a fool layeth open his folly.
verses.en: A sensible person acts on what they know, but a fool spreads his foolishness around.

verses.zh: 奸恶的使者必陷在祸患里；忠信的使臣乃医人的良药。
verses.kjv: A wicked messenger falleth into mischief: but a faithful ambassador is health.
verses.en: A bad messenger falls into trouble, but a trustworthy one brings healing.

verses.zh: 弃绝管教的，必致贫受辱；领受责备的，必得尊荣。
verses.kjv: Poverty and shame shall be to him that refuseth instruction: but he that regardeth reproof shall be honoured.
verses.en: Refusing to be taught brings poverty and shame, but taking correction brings honour.

verses.zh: 所欲的成就，心觉甘甜；远离恶事，为愚昧人所憎恶。
verses.kjv: The desire accomplished is sweet to the soul: but it is abomination to fools to depart from evil.
verses.en: Getting what you longed for is sweet, but fools hate to turn away from what is wrong.

verses.zh: 与智慧人同行的，必得智慧；和愚昧人作伴的，必受亏损。
verses.kjv: He that walketh with wise men shall be wise: but a companion of fools shall be destroyed.
verses.en: Walk with wise people and you will be wise; keep company with fools and you will suffer.

verses.zh: 祸患追赶罪人；义人必得善报。
verses.kjv: Evil pursueth sinners: but to the righteous good shall be repayed.
verses.en: Trouble chases sinners, but good people are paid back with good.

verses.zh: 善人给子孙遗留产业；罪人为义人积存资财。
verses.kjv: A good man leaveth an inheritance to his children’s children: and the wealth of the sinner is laid up for the just.
verses.en: A good person leaves something behind for their grandchildren, but a sinner's wealth ends up with the good.

verses.zh: 穷人耕种多得粮食，但因不义，有消灭的。
verses.kjv: Much food is in the tillage of the poor: but there is that is destroyed for want of judgment.
verses.en: A poor person's field can grow plenty of food, but unfairness sweeps it away.

verses.zh: 不忍用杖打儿子的，是恨恶他；疼爱儿子的，随时管教。
verses.kjv: He that spareth his rod hateth his son: but he that loveth him chasteneth him betimes.
verses.en: Whoever never corrects his son does not really love him; whoever loves him corrects him in good time.

verses.zh: 义人吃得饱足；恶人肚腹缺粮。
verses.kjv: The righteous eateth to the satisfying of his soul: but the belly of the wicked shall want.
verses.en: A good person eats until they are full, but a bad person's stomach goes empty.
